_disclaimer: Illustrative runbooks for demo purposes only. Not official operational procedures.
battery_low_warning: Check solar panel output current on Power subsystem page.
Verify satellite is not in extended eclipse; check ground track.
Reduce payload duty cycle or switch to safe mode if SOC < 15%.
Confirm battery heater is not drawing excess current.
Notify duty engineer if SOC continues to decline.
battery_temp_high_warning: Check thermal subsystem for heater anomaly or blocked radiator.
Reduce battery charge current if above 1C rate.
Switch to eclipse thermal model if satellite is in sunlight longer than expected.
Consider early safe-mode entry if temperature exceeds 45°C.
Log event and cross-reference with radiation dose (SAA crossing?).
bus_temp_high_warning: Verify bus heater status and set-points.
Reduce payload operational time to lower internal dissipation.
Check for stuck-open valve or thermal strap disconnection.
pointing_error_high: Check ADCS mode: is star tracker locked?
Verify reaction wheel speeds are within nominal range.
Check for external torque source (gravity gradient, atmospheric drag, magnetic).
If star-tracker is lost, fall back to coarse Sun sensor attitude.
Issue momentum dump command if wheel speeds are saturated.
wheel_saturation: Issue momentum dump command via magnetic torquer.
Verify magnetic torquer coil currents are nominal.
Reduce slew rate to lower angular momentum buildup.
Check for persistent external torque causing constant wheel acceleration.
radiation_seu_rate: Check if satellite is crossing the South Atlantic Anomaly.
Correlate with NOAA Kp index — elevated Kp increases SEU risk.
Verify error-correcting memory (EDAC) counters; reset if needed.
Consider switching to safe mode during severe radiation event.
Log all SEU events for post-pass analysis.
bus_voltage_low: Check power bus shunt regulator status.
Verify no short-circuit condition on secondary buses.
Reduce non-essential loads to restore voltage margin.
Cross-check with battery SOC — low SOC is expected cause.
comms_anomaly: Verify ground station is tracking and antenna is locked.
Check link budget: elevation angle above mask?
Verify transponder is in correct mode (uplink enable).
Attempt alternate ground station contact if available.
Check for interference or jamming source.
